## Checklist

- [ ] Tests pass in release: `swift test -c release -Xswiftc -enable-testing`
- [ ] New or changed behavior has tests, including continuity tests for new pictures or options
- [ ] New and changed public API has DocC comments
- [ ] New options are documented in the README and DocC
- [ ] Every new source file has the license header
- [ ] Screenshots or a recording are attached for visual changes
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` is updated for user-visible changes
